description: This PHP source file contains the implementation of the function `Contacts_sendCustomerPortalLoginDetails`, which manages customer portal login details for contacts in a CRM system. It handles database queries and updates for user credentials and sends notification emails.

classes.name: Contacts
classes.description: A class presumably managing contact objects, particularly with a method to generate email contents for portal login details.

methods.name: Contacts_sendCustomerPortalLoginDetails
methods.description: Handles creation or update of portal login credentials for a contact entity and sends login details via email.
